provenance.description: Phase 0 evidence inventory, now read by opt-in Phase 1 identity lookups. Conditional aliases require their stated evidence; lookup does not register metadata rules, select decoders, or rewrite persisted keys.

status.settled: The plan fixes this mapping and no open question contradicts it.
status.provisional: An open question in the plan must be answered before this entry is authoritative. The note names the question.

alias_source.contract.modality_key: A modality.key with registered meta fields in euler-dataset-contract today.
alias_source.euler_loading.modality_type: A value of the type field in euler-loading's generated loaders.json.
alias_source.euler_loading.loader_function: A loader function name in euler-loading that is not itself a modality type.
alias_source.dataset.modality_key: A name reported by the operator for the current datasets; separate from emitted loader types.

non_modality_reason.bundle: Several distinct quantities carried under one name.
non_modality_reason.cardinality: The same quantity as a registered modality, repeated per sensor.

domains.geometry: Spatial structure and the transforms relating frames.
domains.appearance: Radiance as an image-forming sensor records it.
domains.semantics: Labels attached to a spatial support.
domains.radiometry: Physical light-transport quantities of the scene.
domains.signal: Container-typed values carrying no committed physical meaning.
domains.kinematics: Pose and motion of the platform carrying the sensors.

subjects.camera: The quantity is attached to a camera and its image plane.
subjects.scene: The quantity is attached to the world, independent of any one sensor.
subjects.grid: Index space: a regular n-dimensional lattice.
subjects.sphere: Index space: directions on the unit sphere.
subjects.platform: The quantity is attached to the vehicle carrying the sensors and its reference frame, such as the GNSS/IMU frame.

appearance.camera.color.subject: camera
appearance.camera.color.description: Colour recorded by a camera, whatever the filter array or channel order.

appearance.camera.gated_intensity.subject: camera
appearance.camera.gated_intensity.description: Intensity a range-gated camera records in one slice: the return of its own pulsed illumination from a band of distances, plus ambient light. Slices with different delays together encode depth.

geometry.camera.depth.subject: camera
geometry.camera.depth.description: Per-pixel distance from the camera, either perpendicular to the image plane or along the ray.

geometry.camera.stereo_disparity.subject: camera
geometry.camera.stereo_disparity.description: Per-pixel horizontal offset between corresponding pixels of a rectified stereo pair, on the reference camera's image plane and in its pixels; depth is focal length times baseline over disparity. Not the relative inverse depth monocular models also call disparity.

geometry.camera.intrinsics.subject: camera
geometry.camera.intrinsics.description: Projection parameters mapping camera-frame points to the image plane.

geometry.camera.extrinsics.subject: camera
geometry.camera.extrinsics.description: Rigid transform between the camera frame and a reference frame.

geometry.scene.points.subject: scene
geometry.scene.points.description: Three-dimensional scene points, either indexed by pixel as a point map or listed as an unordered cloud.

geometry.scene.flow.subject: scene
geometry.scene.flow.description: Per-point or per-pixel scene motion between two times.

semantics.camera.class_labels.subject: camera
semantics.camera.class_labels.description: Per-pixel semantic class, carried either as class ids or as a palette colour that indexes them.

semantics.camera.instance_labels.subject: camera
semantics.camera.instance_labels.description: Per-pixel instance identity, without class meaning.

semantics.camera.panoptic_labels.subject: camera
semantics.camera.panoptic_labels.description: Per-pixel class and instance identity combined in one map.

semantics.camera.mask.subject: camera
semantics.camera.mask.description: Per-pixel membership of one named class. The class is a representation parameter, so a road or vehicle mask needs no new modality.

radiometry.scene.atmospheric_light.subject: scene
radiometry.scene.atmospheric_light.description: Airlight colour of the scene atmosphere.

radiometry.scene.scattering_coefficient.subject: scene
radiometry.scene.scattering_coefficient.description: Extinction/scattering coefficient controlling transmission through the medium, e.g. exp(-beta * distance) in the fog producer. It is distinct from dimensionless transmission.

signal.grid.scalar.subject: grid
signal.grid.scalar.note: Open question 1: for signal.* the subject slot holds an index space rather than a subject. The id may change if a separate convention is adopted for container-typed signals.
signal.grid.scalar.description: A scalar value per cell of a regular grid, with no committed physical meaning.

signal.grid.array.subject: grid
signal.grid.array.note: Open question 1: signal registry naming remains provisional. Current generic map_3d accepts arbitrary channel counts.
signal.grid.array.description: An arbitrary rank-three array; the third axis is not necessarily XYZ or a three-component vector.

geometry.camera.ray_direction.subject: camera
geometry.camera.ray_direction.description: A homogeneous direction per image-plane pixel. Unit length, component order, and coordinate frame require explicit declarations.

radiometry.scene.transmission.subject: scene
radiometry.scene.transmission.description: Fraction of light transmitted along a path, distinct from the extinction coefficient. Actual channel layout and encoding remain dataset-specific.

kinematics.platform.state.subject: platform
kinematics.platform.state.description: The platform's navigation state at one time: position, attitude, velocity and angular rates, as a GNSS/INS solution reports them.

kinematics.platform.pose.subject: platform
kinematics.platform.pose.description: Rigid transform from a sensor or platform frame to the world frame at one time, such as the lidar's pose along its trajectory.

timing.platform.acquisition.subject: platform
timing.platform.acquisition.description: Start and end times at which each sensor acquired one frame, such as the camera exposure and the lidar sweep.

geometry.platform.extrinsics.subject: platform
geometry.platform.extrinsics.description: Rigid transform between a sensor frame and the platform's reference frame, such as lidar to GNSS/IMU.

gated.note: euler-loading's cerema emits it for the CEREMA Pixel-Accurate Depth Benchmark's gated slices, and euler-known-datasets heads use it as their modality key.

disparity.note: euler-loading's driving_stereo emits it for rectified stereo disparity in half-size pixels. Relative inverse depth that monocular models call disparity is a different quantity and must not use this alias.

extrinsics.note: Open question 4: vkitti2.read_extrinsics returns shape Nx1 where the other producers return 4x4. Until that is classified as a representation or a defect, the shared id is asserted for the quantity only.

points_3d.note: Operator confirms dense per-pixel XYZ obtained by projecting a dense depth map. Generic CPU and GPU loaders preserve 3HW; density alone does not make the representation interchangeable with a cloud.

sparse_depth.note: Operator confirms sparse 3D depth; MUSES and Princeton loaders return point clouds. This mapping applies to declared clouds, not an unknown dataset carrying a sparse raster.

semantic_segmentation_color.note: The legacy name suggests encoding rgb_palette, but no declaration carries it. The encoding is recorded per dataset in phase 2, not assumed here.

map_2d.note: Open question 1: the target id's subject slot is unsettled.

map_3d.note: Open question 1: target naming remains provisional. No fixed channel count or geometric meaning may be inferred from map_3d.

spherical_map.note: Operator clarification: the used spherical_map is a homogeneous ray direction map, not a sphere-indexed generic signal. Loading preserves magnitude; preprocessing may renormalize.

athmospheric_light.note: Operator-reported dataset spelling. Loaders spell it atmospheric_light. Preserve both persisted keys; this inventory performs no spelling normalization.

transmission_map.note: Reported active dataset quantity; there is no dedicated emitted loader type in the reviewed loading catalog.

all_intrinsics.description: The same quantity as intrinsics, held once per sensor. It becomes a binding concern (cardinality per_sensor) rather than a separate identity.

calibration.description: A bundle carrying several distinct quantities, typically intrinsics and extrinsics for one or more sensors. It decomposes into separately bound values, each with its own identity.

open_questions.summary: Whether signal.* may use the subject slot for an index space.
Whether vkitti2's Nx1 extrinsics is a real storage representation or a defect.

spectral_map.note: Operator clarifies this name was never used. No spectral-band or spherical-harmonic meaning is inferred and no canonical id is assigned.

resolved_questions.resolution: Operator identifies spherical_map as homogeneous image-plane ray directions. Projection, frame and normalization still require per-dataset declarations.
Operator confirms sparse_depth contains sparse 3D depth; observed loaders consume clouds. The alias is conditional on that representation.

Operator settles gnss, sensor_timing and lidar_to_gnss as the inputs of lidar ego-motion compensation (MUSES). They need the kinematics and timing domains and the platform subject; lidar_to_gnss is a platform mount, not camera extrinsics.

kitti_carla's lidar_pose, the lidar-to-world pose each sample takes from the 1 ms trajectory, settles as kinematics.platform.pose: the pose of the vehicle-mounted sensor in the world, not a sensor-to-camera mount.

driving_stereo's disparity, the horizontal pixel offset of a rectified stereo pair on the left camera's image plane, settles as geometry.camera.stereo_disparity. The id names the stereo pair because monocular depth models use 'disparity' for relative inverse depth, which is not convertible to metres with fx and baseline.
